text: Every Review & Practice mode (review, verse library, games, achievements) keeps the same side panes as the other screens: the left rail for moving between modes and the right panel for context, so a learner can move around without going back and forth. The older mode pages currently have no rail, oversized headings, uneven font sizes and large unused space; they are rebuilt into the three-pane layout after Chris has played with them live.
rationale: Chris reviewed screenshots of the current mode pages: font sizes and free space are a mess; he likes continuing the side panes for continuity and organization
